style: A wry, dim late-night lounge-synth groove in A minor for a scavenger market in a lonely retro pixel-art space game: a mellow electric piano on minor seventh chords, a muted analog synth lead with slow vibrato, a round synth bass walking slowly, a soft brushed drum machine, a low arpeggiator, dusty tape echo and big reverb. Lonely, smoky and slightly sly, like a salvage market at night in the cold; dim, never happy. Purely instrumental. Am, 94 BPM.
